description: This Java interface defines a structure for representing an entity ID with an associated revision, including methods for retrieving the entity ID, the revision number, and an identifier string. It also includes a nested class for JSON field definitions used in serialization.

classes.name: EntityIdWithRevision
classes.description: An interface for an entity ID with revision information, parameterized by the entity ID type, extending Jsonifiable for JSON serialization and IdentifiableStreamingMessage for message identification.

classes.name: EntityIdWithRevision.JsonFields
classes.description: A final class containing static JSON field definitions for 'id' and 'revision', used for JSON serialization/deserialization within EntityIdWithRevision.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the Entity ID of the modified entity.

methods.name: getRevision
methods.description: Returns the revision number of the modified entity.

methods.name: asIdentifierString
methods.description: Provides a string combining the entity ID and revision in the format 'id:revision'.
